My health has been off, and it's affecting my ability to focus."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm sorry to hear that. Health issues can be really disruptive. Do you want to talk about what's been happening?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, I've been getting headaches and feeling fatigued. It's been hard to stay on task, and I'm falling behind on my coursework."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds rough. It's really challenging when you're not feeling your best physically. Have you seen a doctor about the headaches and fatigue?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I haven't yet. I've been trying to manage it on my own, hoping it would pass, but it's not improving."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It might be a good idea to see someone. It's important to take care of yourself first. How are you managing with everything else, like your major and your relationship with Sally?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"The new major is still exciting, but I feel like I'm not giving it my best because of how I'm feeling. As for Sally, things have been a little tense because I haven't been around much."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It seems like there's a lot on your plate. Maybe you could have a conversation with Sally, let her know what's going on with you health-wise?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"You're right, I should talk to her. She's been understanding in the past. I just hate worrying people."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I understand, but people who care about you like to know when you need support.
